facts.label: Said + passado em casa
facts.sub: Para repetir o que alguém da família disse, use said + passado: Mom said dinner was ready. Se disser para quem, use told me: Mom told me it was ready.

facts.label: Repetir o que a família disse
facts.sub: Use said + sujeito + passado: Mom said dinner was ready. Dad said the chicken was hot. Grandma said she was making a pie. É o mesmo padrão das outras aulas.

facts.label: Um passo atrás
facts.sub: Quando alguém falou no presente, voltamos um passo: is vira was, are vira were, am vira was. “Dinner is ready” vira “Mom said dinner was ready”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “Mom said dinner was ready” reports what Mom said.
We say “Mom said dinner is ready” when we report it later.
items.why: Usually: Mom said dinner was ready.

items.s: We can say “Dad said the chicken was hot.”

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “Mom said dinner was ready” reports what Mom said. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Mom said dinner is ready” when we report it later. → Falso (Usually: Mom said dinner was ready.)
We can say “Dad said the chicken was hot.” → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: Said is followed by me: said me.
We can use that after said.
items.why: Yes: said that dinner was ready.

paragraphs: It is a cold Sunday evening in a dining room in Boston. A long wooden table stands under a warm light. Earl puts plates and forks near each chair. The smell of chicken fills the house. His brother Marco comes in with dirty hands. Earl smiles and waves him to the table.

“Marco, Mom said dinner was ready ten minutes ago. Where were you?” says Earl. “I was fixing my bike. She said dinner was ready, but I did not hear her.” says Marco. “She also said the table was not ready, so I set it.” says Earl.
